blurb: `stub Cap.op(…)` overrides one operation of a capability, so `op` must be declared by that capability. A misspelt or renamed operation matches nothing, so the stub is refused instead of leaving the default provider in place unannounced. Use the operation name the capability declares. See `bynk.stub.not_a_seam` when the capability itself is the wrong one.
summary: A test `stub` names an operation the capability does not declare.
